title: On the Density of Periodic Measures for Star Vector Fields
summary: In this paper, we prove that every ergodic hyperbolic invariant measure of a $C^1$ star vector field can be approximated by periodic measures in weak$^*$ topology. This extends a classical result of Katok \cite{Ka} for $C^{1+α}(α>0)$ diffeomorphisms to $C^1$ star vector field of any dimension.
